A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GSSBO study. Their complete main text, figures, equations, theoretical appendix, and experimental appendix support comparison, including matching relocated and combined figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original optimization-regret and runtime experiments on synthetic functions and diabetes hyperparameter optimization, alongside sensitivity and subset-selection analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and adds an empirical comparison of GP predictive RMSE in Appendix B.6.

M1.justification: Section 4.3, Algorithm 1, and Appendix A.1 remove compulsory retention of initial samples, selecting M-1 additional points instead of M-n0-1. The core selection and buffer strategy remain. Inverse-kernel vector embeddings become explicit in Section 4.1, but corresponding gradient columns already appeared in v2's appendix.

E1.justification: The five synthetic functions and diabetes task are retained. New Appendix B.6 does not identify its underlying function or test dataset, and its caption describes a different experiment. Whether this analysis expands dataset or task coverage cannot be established.

E2.justification: GP-UCB, RSSBO, VecchiaBO, LR-First m, SparseGP, IPA, and mini-META remain, as do appendix comparisons with K-means++, REMBO, and HESBO. The new RMSE analysis reuses GP-UCB and RSSBO.

E3.justification: Appendix B.6 introduces per-iteration test RMSE between GP posterior means and true function values, with subset selection starting at iteration 60. This adds an evaluation protocol; the stated main benchmark settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix B.6 tests whether gradient-selected subsets preserve predictive fidelity relative to full-data and random-subset GPs. The existing buffer-parameter sensitivity analysis and sample-distribution study are retained.

E5.justification: v2 Section 6.2 states that each diabetes-task iteration is repeated five times; v3 omits this statement. Both retain the general statement of 50 experimental repetitions. The omission does not establish that fewer repetitions were actually performed.

E6.justification: The main benchmark plots are unchanged. New Figure 11 reports GSSBO predictive RMSE close to the full-data GP, while RSSBO exhibits higher error and variability over time. These are additional findings, not a demonstrated same-setting improvement over v2.

T1.justification: v3 corrects the maximization condition to f(x*) >= f(x) and derives the vector embedding -K^-1 e_i in Equation (3). Appendix A.1 revises the forced-subset definition. The posterior-error bounds and subsequent regret-bound derivations otherwise remain substantively unchanged.

C1.justification: The introduction adds an explicit claim to be the first work using gradient information for subset selection to accelerate BO. The main claims of computational savings, competitive optimization performance, and sublinear regret remain unchanged.

C2.justification: The local-optimum explanation shifts from gradient perturbations to retaining the latest observation. Section 6.1 adds an information-loss explanation for approximate baselines' performance, and Appendix B.6 interprets RMSE similarity as evidence that selected subsets preserve useful information.

D1.justification: v3 adds a UCI repository link but removes the explicit Gaussian gradient-perturbation recipe while retaining the stated noise variance of 0.01. Kernel, hyperparameter, and hardware disclosures remain unchanged; the perturbation implementation is consequently less clearly documented.

R1.justification: v3 removes the introductory references on additive manufacturing and inertial-confinement fusion and adds explicit first-use positioning. The substantive related-work survey otherwise remains largely unchanged after matching numerical and author-year citations.

P1.justification: The introduction and selected method paragraphs receive targeted rewrites, scalar/vector terminology is clarified, keywords and front matter change, and citations switch to author-year style. The overall section organization and most existing prose are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 2 moves, Figures 3-4 are enlarged and stacked, and the former Deep Kernel and BNN Figures 10-11 become one Figure 10 with a shared legend. A new RMSE Figure 11 is added, but its caption incorrectly describes the surrogate-regret experiment.

improvement.justification: The clearer vector construction, corrected maximization definition, new predictive-fidelity diagnostic, and more readable plots provide a limited net improvement. Gains are constrained by the unspecified RMSE test setting and incorrect caption, lost perturbation and repetition details, and Section 4.2 still mentioning initial-sample retention despite the revised algorithm.
